```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - epic
      - develop

jobs:
  ci:
    name: Run CI
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

  notify-code-owners:
    name: Notify Code Owners
    needs: ci
    if: ${{ success() }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Notify code owners
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          body: |
            ✅ CI passed for PR #${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}. Ready for review.
```
